reviews.text: Needs Update. The app is missing some newer songs from the recent months. Other than that, I love the app, and love that you can transpose without a limit for free.

Better Than One Might Think. At first I thought that this was a rather simple plain Jane guitar app. 

However, after hours of use and only one ad, I then discovered the powerful transposition feature on the left rail, the history and favorites feature in the menu, and a deeper selection of complex songs in its search feature (for example, the entire B Side Abbey Road Medley in a single chart, which I now play along with), I felt compelled to write an app review, not an easy thing to do since the app is farther down from the more popular apps, all of which I have tried and for one reason or another deleted. 

Thank you developers for making this rather exceptional and powerful app available for free. Other apps require subscription for what this fully featured app offers for free. 

Anyway, I strongly recommend this wonderful App to anyone who loves guitar and learning to play both popular and more difficult challenges such as I mentioned above. 

Well, now then, back to practice…
